menu_options.samsung_token: Provide refresh token directly (2FA / social login)

samsung_login.title: Samsung Account — Email and Password
samsung_login.description: Enter your [Samsung Account]({samsung_account_url}) credentials. This only works for accounts where two-step verification is disabled.

samsung_token.title: Samsung Account — Refresh Token
samsung_token.description: Paste a Samsung IoT refresh token. See the [README]({readme_url}) for instructions on how to capture it from your browser (one-time setup).

pat.title: SmartThings Personal Access Token
pat.description: Create a token at [account.smartthings.com]({token_url}). Tokens expire after 24 hours.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your token expired. Create a new one at [account.smartthings.com/tokens]({token_url}).

error.invalid_samsung_auth: Invalid Samsung Account email or password.
error.samsung_2fa: 2FA is enabled on this account. Go back and choose 'Provide refresh token directly'.
error.samsung_auth_error: Samsung Account authentication failed. Check credentials and try again.
error.invalid_samsung_token: Invalid or expired refresh token. Capture a fresh one and try again.
